## Plan + test matrix

1. **Registry field** — `connectors/registry.py` gains `volatility_class` +
   `volatility_basis` on `SourceRecord` (closed §28.3 vocabulary; a declared
   class requires a recorded basis — a basis-less class fails validation, so a
   guessed class can never land). `sources.toml` declares `SLOW` for the
   camera-registry emit surfaces (`camreg_*`, `dot_511_*`) with the ADR-104(e)
   basis; every other source stays undeclared → `not_evaluable`.
2. **Freshness emit** — `shaping.py`: a new `freshness_observations` read covers
   ALL predicates (deduped latest dated observation per source/subject/predicate,
   publishable-effective only), so the non-site evidence sources (procurement/
   legislative/CCOPS/federal) get rows; `source_stats`/`source_runs` drop their
   site-predicate filter so run dates cover them too. `freshness_row()` emits
   `staleness_not_evaluable`; `status`/`volatility_class` read `not_evaluable`
   where staleness cannot be evaluated (undeclared class, or zero evaluable
   observations) — never `ok`/`stale 0`.
3. **Class-aware evaluation** — `inference/freshness.py`: `SourceFreshness`
   carries `staleness_evaluable` + `not_evaluable_count`; `source_freshness()`
   takes the source's declared class — staleness is evaluated only against a
   declared class.
4. **Map-table suppression parity** — `map.ts` `binCountLabel` is the single
   suppression decision feeding the figure text, the accessible table and the
   SVG `<title>` (new `binAriaLabel`); `deviceCount` → `recordCount` records
   framing (SIG-RECON-058), `deviceCount` kept as a deprecated wire alias.
5. **Cell→jurisdiction reconciliation** — `analytics._density_bins` keys each
   cell's jurisdiction on the scheme-qualified key: the placement run's
   `jurisdiction_key` when bound (P35.19), else the site's declared-scheme
   bucket; each bin emits the full `jurisdiction_counts` map so
   Σ-cell counts per key reconcile with the dossier's geolocated denominator —
   a cell's sum can no longer disagree with a dossier count without the
   plurality-assignment disclosure being visible. The rule is recorded in the
   payload (`jurisdiction_rule`).
6. **Trace re-derivation** — the b-half oracle rows (C3-T002/T152/T284–T304
   freshness, C3-T317–T320 bins) re-derive over the new emit; mismatches are
   named residuals, never trace edits.
7. **Tests** — exports (row emission, non-site rows, declared/undeclared
   evaluability, bin reconciliation), connectors (registry field validation),
   inference (class-aware gating), web (not-evaluable rendering, suppression
   parity incl. SVG title, records framing).

## Trace re-derivation (oracle `number_trace.csv` untouched)

Re-derivation ran over a REAL export built by
`scripts/ci/build_from_spine_fixture_export.py` (PostGIS container +
`run_spine_export` over the seeded `tests/db` spine — the same path the
national export runs). Emitted bytes: `docs/build/logs/p35_20b/export/`
(`web/freshness.json` sha256 `f518e48b…`, `web/analytics/density_bins.json`
sha256 `168e5da0…`).

- **C3-T284/T285/T286** (178×"ok" / 178×"unknown" / all-"stale 0") — the
  defect classes are gone in the re-derived emit: the seeded fixture's
  undeclared sources read `status: not_evaluable` + `volatility_class:
  not_evaluable` + a positive `staleness_not_evaluable` count (3 for the
  dated camreg fixture sources), never "ok" and never a fabricated
  measured-0. Where the registry declares a class (the 279 `camreg_*`/
  `dot_511_*` rows) the emit reads that declared `SLOW` class instead of
  the inherited `unknown`.
- **C3-T002 / C3-T287** (178 rows vs 219 evidence sources; 41 non-site
  sources rowless) — the row population is now the union of the
  all-predicate `freshness_observations` sources and the de-filtered
  `source_stats`/`source_runs` sources: every source with publishable claims
  (procurement/legislative/CCOPS/federal included) emits a row. The seeded
  export proves a non-site source (`muckrock`) emits a `not_evaluable` row.
- **C3-T288–T303** (sampled rows' `ok`/0/`unknown`) — the rows now carry
  `staleness_not_evaluable` and the declared/not_evaluable class; the
  per-source run dates are unchanged derivations (`last_successful_run`,
  `last_content_change` fields untouched by this row).
- **C3-T317/T319** ("Devices" column, Σ=227,335) — header renamed to
  "Records" (SIG-RECON-058); wire fields `recordCount` (canonical) +
  `deviceCount` (deprecated alias, one release cycle) emit both; the web
  seam folds `deviceCount`→`recordCount`.
- **C3-T318** (601 low-coverage cells printed 40,913 records; SVG `<title>`
  carried the count) — `binCountLabel`/`coverageEncoding` is now the ONE
  suppression decision; the figure text, the accessible table cell, and the
  SVG `<title>` (via `binAriaLabel`) all read "suppressed"/"record count
  suppressed"; e2e `map-network.nojs.spec.ts` asserts no suppressed title
  carries a record figure.
- **C3-T320** (cell-jurisdiction sums ≠ dossier geolocated counts:
  CA 662 vs 6,139) — cells now key on the scheme-qualified key (placement
  `jurisdiction_key` when the P35.19 run is bound, else the P35.18
  declared-scheme bucket) and emit `jurisdiction_counts` — the full per-key
  split — so a plurality label is never mistaken for the whole cell and the
  per-key sums reconcile exactly; the emit's `jurisdiction_rule` names the
  rule. The bare-label collision class (`CO`/`ID` mixing) survives only on
  honestly-undeclared claims, disclosed as-is.
- **Named residual R-P35.20b-1:** the trace's national magnitudes
  (601 suppressed cells totalling 40,913; CA 662 vs dossier 6,139; the
  exact new freshness row count over 219 evidence sources; per-cell
  `jurisdiction_counts` splits) cannot be re-derived without the live
  spine — the next materialization emits the corrected numbers. The
  fixture-spine re-derivation proves the mechanics (emitted schema, honest
  states, reconciliation); it does not reproduce national counts. No
  residual-free closure is claimed.
- **Named residual R-P35.20b-2:** a source carrying evidence artifacts but
  zero publishable claims still gets no freshness row (the row population is
  claim-bearing sources via `claim_source`/`source_stats`); the "219 with
  evidence → all get a row" claim holds only where evidence backs a claim.
  Not fabricated into the emit.
